title: Planning and delivery: people, capacity and projects
description: Plan people by skills and availability, pencil them in before a deal closes, and run projects with milestones and a client portal.
teaser: People by skills and availability, pencilled in early, projects with milestones.
h1: Plan people before the contract is signed
lead: Operations sees every booking, every conflict and every person's capacity in one grid. People can be pencilled in while a deal is still open and confirmed the moment it is won, and everyone affected hears about it.

heroScreen.describes: Allocation grid by person and week

features.title: Pencilled in, then confirmed
features.text: Book people softly while a deal is open, and confirm them when it is won. Each person sees where they are pencilled in, and when it becomes firm.

features.title: Capacity at a glance
features.text: Each person's load against their own working week: green under 80%, amber when fully booked, red when over. Double bookings are flagged before they happen.

screen.describes: Capacity per person with conflicts flagged

features.title: The right people for the work
features.text: A skills matrix with levels and languages shows who can do what, and where the gaps are for a project.

features.title: Projects your clients can follow
features.text: Milestones, a charter the client signs, and a portal where they follow progress without an account.

signals.text: Bookings change, and the people involved know straight away.
